{{Quote|But just the same, Kels, don't toss 'em around. These are sensitive pieces of work, and if you rattle 'em too much they could misfire or not go off at all.|Dawson discussing his explosives with Kels Turkhorn|<ref name="GHH" />}}
'''Dawson''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Tynnan/Legends|Tynnan]] demolitions operative and a member of [[Thief/Legends|thief]] [[Cecil Noone]]'s [[Cecil Noone's crew|crew]] as of [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. An expert in explosives who loved playing [[water-wall]] and creating and [[Detonator/Legends|detonating]] [[Bomb/Legends|bombs]] in his [[Youngling/Legends|youth]], Dawson fled his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Tynna/Legends|Tynna]] after being chosen by lottery to fill a vacancy in the [[Tynnan government]]. Hiring himself out as a bomb maker to several underworld clients before meeting Noone, Dawson's talents were an asset to Noone's crew as they carried out operations from [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] to [[Kabal/Legends|Kabal]].

Dawson took part in Noone's [[Heist on the Song of the Clouds|mission]] to the [[Ithorian Herdship|Ithorian herdship]] ''[[Song of the Clouds]]'' to retrieve a mysterious [[lockbox]] for [[Guttu]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], during which he risked his life to infiltrate a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord's]] [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] docked at the herdship to find the item. Noone's gang stole the yacht and made off with the treasure from the lockbox, revealed to be a [[Hapes/Legends|Hapan]] [[Gun of Command]]. Dawson and the others accompanied Noone to Kabal, where Noone tried to sell the [[Blaster/Legends|Gun]] to [[Krish/Legends|Krish]] business magnate [[Tyro Viveca/Legends|Tyro Viveca]]. While there, Dawson's mania for collecting [[Quay novelty toy]]s came in handy for Noone, who was in need of rescue from [[Tyro Viveca's estate|Viveca's estate]] when Viveca began [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] him. Dawson was able to fashion an improvised detonator from one of the novelties and set off a powerful bomb that [[Death/Legends|killed]] Viveca. With Noone safe, Dawson treated the ailing thief as the group escaped the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
[[File:HighNoone.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Dawson (far right) joined Cecil Noone's crew.]]
A [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="DawDate" /> [[Tynnan/Legends|Tynnan]], Dawson was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on<ref name="GHH" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="EssGuiPlaMoo">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> [[Tynna/Legends|Tynna]]. During the first eighteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of his life, a coterie of wealthy uncles attempted to interest Dawson in a career in the [[stock market]], but he showed no interest in any kind of work; rather, Dawson spent his [[Youngling/Legends|youth]] playing the game of [[water-wall]] and finding creative ways to cause explosions.<ref name="GHH" />

One [[Standard day/Legends|day]], however, a congratulatory message to Dawson informed him that he had been selected by lottery to fill a vacancy in the [[Tynnan government]]. Revolted at the prospect of spending his life in community meetings and [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] platform control legislation, Dawson left his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], never to return, and offered his services as a demolitions operative to various underworld clients. He eventually joined up with the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Thief/Legends|thief]] [[Cecil Noone]] and his [[Cecil Noone's crew|crew]] of professional criminals aboard the [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighter]] ''[[Borogove]]''.<ref name="GHH" />

===Having a blast===
====The Great Herdship Heist====
{{Quote|Two days! Two days to get aboard ''this'', and steal their precious box? Did that diseased slug realize that they're sealing off all space traffic to keep the meeting private?|Dawson weighing up the latest job|<ref name="GHH" />}}
[[File:FlightOfDawson.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Dawson stuffed into an Ithorian vacsuit]]
Four years into Dawson's career with Noone's crew<ref name="GHH" /> around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="DawDate" /> the ''Borogove'' went to ground in the [[Kamar Badlands|badlands]] of<ref name="GHH" /> the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="KamarWhere">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Kamar system/Legends|Kamar system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="HanSoRev">''[[Han Solo's Revenge]]''</ref> [[Kamar/Legends|Kamar]] after an altercation with a [[Sector Ranger/Legends|Sector Ranger]] [[Patrol boat/Legends|patrol boat]]. While repairs to the vessel were effected, Dawson roped his colleague [[Kels Turkhorn]] into trialing a collection of explosives at a dry lake bed.<ref name="GHH" />

Upon returning to the ''Borogove'', [[Sluissi]] crewmember [[Hass Sonax]] informed the two that [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Guttu]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] had contacted the crew with a [[Heist on the Song of the Clouds|job]]&mdash;Noone's group were to infiltrate a meeting between Bimm crime lord [[Ritinki]] and [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] kingpin [[Vop]], and steal a valuable Ithorian [[lockbox]] that both sought to acquire. The heist was to take place on the [[Ithorian Herdship|Ithorian herdship]] ''[[Song of the Clouds]]'' near the<ref name="GHH" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]; Dawson was dismayed when he was apprised of the timeframe for the job&mdash;two days, while traffic to and from the herdship was restricted.<ref name="GHH" />

As the meeting was being catered, Noone and Turkhorn disguised themselves as staff from the [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodservice]] providers [[Estimable Epicures]] to get aboard the herdship while Dawson and Sonax were stuffed into a [[Metal/Legends|metal]] handcart allegedly containing [[charbote root]] in [[gumbah pudding]]. Once the infiltration was complete, Dawson used a [[Fusioncutter/Legends|fusion cutter]] to cut through a [[Hull/Legends|bulkhead]] to access the [[safe]] containing the prize, and breached the safe itself with four pellets of [[putty]] loaded with [[Nergon-14/Legends|Nergon-14]] explosive. However, the safe was empty.<ref name="GHH" />

Dawson deduced that the lockbox was likely aboard Ritinki's [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]], the ''[[Asaari Wind]]''; defying an order from Noone to pull out, the two broke into an unoccupied berth near where the ''Asaari Wind'' was docked. Dawson donned an [[Ithorian vacsuit]], while Sonax reluctantly climbed into an equipment [[Sled/Legends|sled]], and Dawson launched them out of an [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]] into [[Realspace/Legends|space]] toward the yacht. Although he nearly lost control of the suit and sled, Dawson was able to cut through the hull and get aboard the ship with Sonax. The plan was complicated when Ritinki remotely summoned the ''Asaari Wind'' using a [[Beckon call/Legends|beckoncall]] and the ship began to power up; however, Dawson and Sonax took control of the vessel and turned its weapons on Ritinki as he attempted to board. Noone and Turkhorn were able to reach the yacht and the crew escaped on their new ship with the lockbox, the contents revealed to be a [[Hapes/Legends|Hapan]] [[Gun of Command]], in their possession.<ref name="GHH" />

====Sojourn on Kabal====
{{Quote|Kels! Just handling a delicate bit of negotiating.|Dawson to Kels Turkhorn on Kabal|<ref name="FP">{{GamerCite|1|Fair Prey}}</ref>}}
Following the heist on the ''Song of the Clouds'', Noone attempted to sell the Gun of Command to agents of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. After both deals fell through, the [[Krish/Legends|Krish]] business magnate [[Tyro Viveca/Legends|Tyro Viveca]] expressed interest in the item, and Noone's posse traveled on the ''Asaari Wind''&mdash;by then known as the ''Spiraling Shape''&mdash;to the coastal community of [[Palisade]] on the<ref name="FP" /> Outer Rim<ref name="TEA Kabal">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Kabal system/Legends|Kabal system]]</ref> world [[Kabal/Legends|Kabal]] to meet with him. While in Palisade, Dawson squabbled with a [[Unidentified Squib trader (Kabal)|Squib trader]] over a [[Quay novelty toy]], aiming to acquire it and add it to a small collection he had been amassing. When Turkhorn vocally dismissed the Quay in an effort to surreptitiously secure several [[Power coupling/Legends|power couplings]] and inadvertently left the toy behind, Dawson was crestfallen and soothed himself with a bundle of [[maraffa twig]]s. He later returned to the [[Squib/Legends|Squib]]'s stall, and was eventually able to obtain the device in return for three [[Detonator/Legends|blasting caps]] and a [[Copper/Legends|copper]] spindle.<ref name="FP" />

When the group traveled to [[Tyro Viveca's estate|Viveca's estate]] to rescue Noone, who had been negotiating with the crime [[Lord/Legends|lord]] and was being [[Hunting/Legends|hunted]] for sport by Viveca, Dawson's detonators were rendered unusable by a [[Security droid/Legends|security droid's]] [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. Nevertheless, and despite sustaining an injury to his [[Bone/Legends|ribs]] in the chaos, Dawson was able to use [[maraffa sap]] to rig his undamaged Quay novelty toy as a detonator and [[Death/Legends|kill]] Viveca with the associated [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]], and the crew was able to save Noone. Back aboard the ''Spiraling Shape'', Dawson attempted to treat Noone with a [[medkit]], though its contents were ill-suited for Noone's injuries, which required [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]]. As local authorities closed in, the yacht was forced to make an escape. Despite Dawson's horror at the fact that the [[landing shackle]] was still engaged, the ship was able to take off and leave Kabal, though it sustained structural damage in doing so.<ref name="FP" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Uh oh.|Dawson reacting to an alarming development|<ref name="GHH" />}}
Dawson was prone to being impulsive, single-minded, and oblivious to his surroundings; however, he was a skilled demolitions operative nonetheless. He was also fond of Sonax, despite their frequent clashes of personality. Dawson suffered from [[vertigo]], having experienced a serious episode roughly two years before joining Noone's crew, and resultantly avoided extravehicular activity. However, he was able to manage his anxiety while getting himself and Sonax aboard the ''Asaari Wind''.<ref name="GHH" /> Dawson also experienced intense obsessions with collecting random items such as Quay novelty toys, and would abruptly lose interest in doing so.<ref name="FP" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|Dawson, for pity's sake, I thought you were an expert. Why'd it blow up early?|Kels Turkhorn questioning Dawson's prowess|<ref name="GHH" />}}
A thief and explosives expert, Dawson was skilled in the use of [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]], [[Missile/Legends|missile]] weapons, and [[Grenade launcher/Legends|grenade launchers]], and was well-versed in the fields of survival and [[Transport/Legends|space transport]] repair.<ref name="GHH" /> He was also adept at improvising bombs and traps from unusual items, including a Quay novelty toy.<ref name="FP" /> Dawson was physically strong and an exemplary swimmer, and was proficient in bypassing security measures.<ref name="GHH" />

==Equipment==
{{Dialogue|Hass Sonax|Careful! Thossse are explosssivesss!|Kels Turkhorn|Not without arming pins, they're not. Right, Dawson?|Dawson|She's right, Sonax.|attr=Hass Sonax, Kels Turkhorn, and Dawson discussing the Tynnan's wares|src=<ref name="GHH" />}}
Dawson carried timers, triggers, detonators, putty, raw [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]], [[Thermite/Legends|thermite]] gel, shaped [[Detonite/Legends|detonite]], and vials of Nergon-14 along with other assorted gadgets in a satchel.<ref name="FP" /> Dawson also possessed a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] and safe-cracking tools. To ameliorate his naturally poor sight, Dawson wore an [[ocular enhancer]] over his [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. He was also able to use an Ithorian vacsuit in a pinch.<ref name="GHH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dawson first appeared in the short story "[[The Great Herdship Heist]]," which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and featured in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 15|fifteenth issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' in [[November]] [[1997]]. The illustrations of Dawson in the issue were drawn by [[Will Warren]].<ref name="GHH" />
